snippet.title: Your Factory Has Until Nightfall | Mineral Zone Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4592680/

Survive the night. Build for what comes next.

Mineral Zone is a Tower Defense x Automation game where you gather resources, expand your base, automate production and prepare your defenses for increasingly dangerous nights.

Build. Automate. Defend. Survive.

- Build and automate your production
- Create powerful defenses
- Gather resources and expand your base
- Survive increasingly difficult nights
- Play together in co-op
- See how long you can survive

Mineral Zone is currently in development.

🎮 Wishlist Mineral Zone on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4592680/Mineral_Zone/

💬 Join the Discord:
https://discord.gg/baUMhNAy9X

If you like games such as Mindustry, Factorio and automation-focused tower defense games, Mineral Zone might be for you.

#MineralZone #TowerDefense #AutomationGame #IndieGame #gaming
